rejection_reason.detail: The nonperiodic gradient fix removed opposite-face wrapping, but the finest-level closure still differentiated macroscopic values stored inside the immersed solid. Those populations originate from prolongated flow state and are not a physical wall velocity, so near-wall SGS viscosity was not admissible.

corrective_action.collision_contract: Gradient SGS collision now accepts a boolean solid mask and explicit three-component wall velocity; masked velocities are imposed before WALE/Vreman invariants are evaluated.
corrective_action.checkpoint_contract: Every nested checkpoint now stores one solid mask per hierarchy level so bounded-memory postprocessing uses the identical mask.

conclusion: Both trajectories were stopped before the first checkpoint and are implementation-rejection evidence only.
